# vcell-hy3s builds with Homebrew GCC on macOS, not Apple Clang.
#
# Hy3S is Fortran, and Clang has no Fortran compiler at all. gfortran's runtime
# links against libstdc++, so the libc++ toolchain the ODE solver repo uses is
# not an option either -- hence gcc and libstdc++11 below.
#
# Conan Center publishes no macOS binaries for a GCC profile, so anything that
# does come from Conan compiles from source here. That cost is small in this
# repo: libcurl is the only dependency, and only when messaging is enabled.
# NetCDF is vendored, for the reasons in README.md.
#
# Version pinned to 13 to match Linux-AMD64_profile.txt; the runners also carry
# 14, 15 and 16.
[settings]
arch=x86_64
build_type=Release
compiler=gcc
compiler.version=13
compiler.libcxx=libstdc++11
compiler.cppstd=20
os=Macos

[conf]
# Required: conanfile.py's layout() only flattens the tree to build/generators
# when this is set. Without it, cmake_layout() emits build/Release/generators.
tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja

[options]
fPIC=True
shared=False
